title: Our balloon basket was built for four. With zero wind, it kept tilting toward the empty corner
description:
It was Dad's sixtieth, a balloon flight at dawn over a valley full of mist. Our pilot said there wasn't a breath of wind, and she was right. The balloon hung as still as a painting.

The basket leaned anyway, toward the one corner nobody was standing in. And every time the burner roared and lit up the mist, something out there was a little nearer, and a little more put together.

It's made up. Built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have told Dad the truth up there in the basket, or waited until you landed?
